notes.title: Korean translation added
notes.content:
​Hello everyone,

I'm making a quick post to let you know that my free yandere yuri VN, It gets so lonely here, has been translated into Korean by ClaRet. I'm very happy that the game is now available in another language so even more people can enjoy it!

As always, if you find any bugs or typos in the game, please feel free to let me know. I will try to fix everything in a timely manner. Thank you!

- ebi x

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
​Hi everyone,

Just posting a quick devlog to say that I've uploaded a new version of ​Lonely ​which fixes several typos in the French script of the game. Thank you to Vi for helping out; it's very much appreciated!

I hope the VN will be just a little more polished now, so more people can enjoy it!

- ebi

tags.bug: - Fixed several typos in the French script of the game.

notes.title: French translation added
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! I'm writing a quick post to let you know that [i]It gets so lonely here[/i] has been translated into French by Hugo Lorenzini and Shozutko! Now even more people can check out the game in
another language!

I'd like to thank the translators for their hard work, and I hope you'll enjoy this newest build of Lonely.

As always, please let me know if you find any typos or bugs in the game, and I'll try to fix them when I can. Thank you for your continued support over the years!

- ebi

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese translation added
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm writing a quick post to let you know that It gets so lonely here has been translated into Brazilian Portuguese by [url=https://x.com/notFepulo]Fepulo[/url]! I hope you will enjoy the update, and that even more people can enjoy this story!

As always, if you find any issues with this update, please let me know, and I will try to fix things when I can.

Thank you for all of the continued support, and thank you everybody who read Lonely and who left a review. I'm glad this story was able to reach so many people, and that you all seem to enjoy it!

- ebi

notes.title: Chinese translation added
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm writing a quick update to let you know that It gets so lonely here has been translated into Chinese by the kind people at Yuri Atelier! Thanks to them, the VN should be accessible to even more people. I hope you enjoy it!

I had to recode a few parts of the game to work with the new translation, so do let me know if you find any bugs in the story.

As always, thank you for your support!

- ebi x

notes.title: Ukrainian translation added
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm writing a quick post to let you know that a new build of Lonely has been released (ooh, how exciting) which adds a brand new translation into the game: Ukrainian!

Thank you very much to vrsstk for translating this VN, and to Lacki23 for editing it! Their contributions are very much appreciated!

I also made some edits to the UI, as some of the spacing was off in the extras menu, particularly in the German and Russian translation.

Thank you very much for supporting Lonely! I'm blown away by how many people have checked out this humble little VN! I'm very grateful to each and every one of you!!!

As always, let me know if this update has introduced any bugs into the game, and I'll try to fix them in a timely manner.

- ebi x
